:::{#exr-transpose-sum-practice}
#### Transposing a sum of two matrices

@thm-transpose-sum lets a [transpose](#def-matrix-transpose) be taken before or after adding,
whichever is less work.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 2 & 0 \\ 3 & -1 & 4},
\qquad
\matr{B} = \sbmat{0 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & 2 & -3}.
$$

Find $\tp{(\matr{A} + \matr{B})}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Add first with @def-matrix-addition,
then take the [transpose](#def-matrix-transpose).

:::

:::
